title: Thirdway projects
description: A pinned, full-window project showcase, one window-height of scroll per project. Each photo wipes up from the bottom over the previous one (clip-path, scrubbed with the scroll), carrying a hairline, a circled 01 / 04 counter, a 72px project name with its location, scope and serif team name, and a client quote at the right. On hover a centred 'View project' link appears; on phones the link sits at the bottom.
notes: forces the dark colour scope: cream type over photos, with a bottom fade from the theme's background
window-sized: n × 100svh (400svh for four projects), pinned with position: sticky; the wipes are CSS view-timeline animations
without scroll-driven animation or under reduced motion the projects stack one after another, one window tall each
photos are slots (placeholder until filled); the original's slow inner parallax on each photo is not rebuilt
the sections after it need an opaque background
